gap_dispositions.finding: No dedicated live adapter or portable arrival trace was found. Raw whole-file snapshot retention in ParquetPartitionStore is reusable but is not capture-before-decode of live frames, malformed bytes, reconnects or subscriptions.
gap_dispositions.disposition: RAW_APPEND: full raw bytes durable before decode, journal integrity/torn-tail recovery, finite synthetic fault harness only (T25–28). Actual provider capture gated.

gap_dispositions.finding: Clocks stores UTC fields but lacks monotonic receipt, boot/clock epoch and explicit UTC adjustment. Caller supplied received provenance is not evidence of an actual measured receipt.
gap_dispositions.disposition: Paired UTC/monotonic+boot record envelope; preserve adjustment evidence, crossboot elapsed null and source-clock uncertainty (T02–05).

gap_dispositions.finding: CriticalReactor schedules with UTC time_ns; TimerJournal rejects backward UTC, OrderLedger rejects regressed known time. Preserve actual clock discontinuity and use monotonic elapsed scheduling through an adapter; do not rewrite raw clocks.
gap_dispositions.disposition: Replay ordinal/logical synthetic wrappers preserve raw UTC; due monotonic timers and explicit adjustment markers. Existing UTC-only kernels unchanged and incompatible paths rejected (T04,T15).

gap_dispositions.finding: OptionalWorkers measures monotonic duration but UTC completion/cost chronology can fail on a wall-clock step. Constructor starts a worker thread and restart abandons accepted pending work, so this is not a deterministic captured-completion replay driver.
gap_dispositions.disposition: Use explicit captured completion records and pure callback state; no thread or current wall clock. Restart replays completion fact at same availability (T16–17).

gap_dispositions.finding: PartitionMerge assumes unique partition/sequence under static domain config. Reconnect sequence resets and subscription generations need explicit epochs; provider sequence is not a global delivery tie-breaker.
gap_dispositions.disposition: Explicit source generation/subscription/cursor markers; provider sequence scoped to generation and arrival ordinal globally orders deliveries (T06,T09,T12).

gap_dispositions.finding: ReplayEvent equality rejects changed receipt under the same ID. Distinguish raw delivery identity from economic identity; preserve repeated receipts while preventing double economic application in F05.
gap_dispositions.disposition: Separate delivery ID, exact write retry, economic dedup/conflict semantics (T07–08,T29–30).

gap_dispositions.finding: VersionStore freeze/publication kernels are reusable. Compare semantic outputs separately from transport/provenance hashes where actual receipt versus modeled scenario differs; retain both, never silently ignore timing differences.
gap_dispositions.disposition: Semantic/version and timing/transport comparisons separate, served-version comparison at each record cut (T01–02,T17,T36).

gap_dispositions.finding: No unified source/timer/completion/order driver, seeded named fault registry or minimal divergent-prefix diagnostic exists in the reviewed scope.
gap_dispositions.disposition: One deterministic record driver with explicit callbacks, seeded literal fault schedule and earliest minimal leading prefix (T10,T15–16,T20,T22,T31–34).

gap_dispositions.finding: CriticalReactor crash redelivery requires idempotent external handlers; its local journal does not establish externally exactly-once broker effects.
gap_dispositions.disposition: Atomic pure callback transitions with detached state and no external effects; only offline replay exactly-once state application claimed (T18,T31).

gap_dispositions.finding: RuntimeCosts has compute wall p95/p99, CPU and censored count; receipt lag p50/p95/p99, drops, explicit denominators and source/session clock uncertainty remain to implement and measure.
gap_dispositions.disposition: Nearest-rank qualified synthetic quantiles and evidenced expected-population denominators; null absent denominator/sample; actual live distributions gated (T23,T35).

gap_dispositions.finding: F12 ownership in verify runtime covers synthetic F04 assertions only. Runtime ports do not declare a dedicated implemented F12 trace service. Static contracts and ownership do not close F12.
gap_dispositions.disposition: Proposed F12.ARRIVAL_TRACE.v1 operations and narrow files; shared graph/verify binding requires root review+registration, not ownership inference.

gap_dispositions.finding: normalize_mbp accepts optional strategy_received_at but native_mbp/parquet_mbp wrappers require modeled scenarios with no measured-capture passthrough. Native historical data cannot certify actual receipt.
gap_dispositions.disposition: Existing historical readers unchanged; T03 only certifies modeled-versus-actual distinction. Actual capture/provider passthrough remains gated.

gap_dispositions.finding: Actual field/depth evidence gates are reusable. Adapter integration must choose certified F06/F07 eligibility semantics; legacy AvailabilityIndex priority differs and must not cause late older state resurrection.
gap_dispositions.disposition: Wrapper delegates certified F06/F07 eligible-at-cut semantics, preserves delayed BBO and source-loss incidents without retroactive mutation (T13–14,T20,T24).

gap_dispositions.finding: OrderLedger is simulated only. No actual broker position reconciliation, account rights or external order-state feed is established.
gap_dispositions.disposition: Explicit synthetic ack callback boundary and stale-state rejection; preserve existing order kernel. No broker sends, positions or account claims (T18–19).

gap_dispositions.finding: Vendor docs have no complete SSE event-ID/timestamp/velocity schema or proprietary level formula. Keep snapshots/velocity/keepalive/gap distinct. A keepalive is not a market observation.
gap_dispositions.disposition: Opaque raw bytes and typed connection/subscription/gap markers; no fabricated vendor schema/formulas; provider adapters remain gated (T11–12,T25).

gap_dispositions.finding: Bar timestamps are open times, not publication or receipt; countback may override from; no_data is not zero volume. Optional buy/sell totals do not recover CVD extrema or path.
gap_dispositions.disposition: Preserve interval end/finalization/receipt and unavailable no_data; endpoint polling equality does not reconstruct path (T21,T24).

gap_dispositions.finding: API coming-soon versus limited-beta and MCP 38 versus 40 tool counts are versioned documentation differences. Account access, caps, pricing and permissions remain unverified.
gap_dispositions.disposition: Captured claims/sourceprep pinned; no API access, fee, schema or proprietary formula certification.
